newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Croesus sees sharp gold output rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Croesus sees sharp gold output rise.

text.p: Gold miner Croesus Mining NL said on Wednesday it expected to increase annual production to 100,000 ounces within two years as it expanded its Binduli mine near Kalgoorlie in Western Australia and considered other opportunities with partner Eldorado Gold Corp Inc.

Executive chairman Ron Manners said the 1995/96 financial year had been the company's most successful with a rise in net profit to A$5.67 million from A$4.32 million a year ago and record gold production of 38,817 ounces.
Manners said Binduli's reserves had risen 106 percent to 360,000 ounces, providing nine years of mill feed.
Manners said Croesus had taken steps to improve its status as a Western Australian gold producer.
"The catalyst in our plan to diversify away from Kalgoorlie was the emergence of Eldorado Gold Corp of Canada with an 18 percent interest and now, our largest shareholder," he said.

The two companies were involved in building a significant landholding in New South Wales within the highly prospective Lachlan Fold Belt and were also evaluating several opportunities in the South West Pacific.
